composition._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
composition.rule_of_thirds: Primary subject at upper-right or upper-left third intersection. Horizon line on upper or lower third. Creates dynamic tension and natural eye flow
composition.golden_ratio: Subject positioned at golden spiral focal point (0.618 from any edge). Spiral flow guides eye through frame. More organic and pleasing than rule of thirds
composition.centered_symmetry: Subject dead-center with mirror symmetry left/right. Conveys formality, power, and stability. Use for hero products and authoritative portraits
composition.leading_lines: Converging lines (roads, architecture, shadows, perspective) draw eye from edges to subject at vanishing point. Creates depth and guides attention
composition.negative_space: 60-70% of frame is empty space, subject occupies 30-40%. Creates breathing room, elegance, and space for text overlay. Essential for editorial and advertising
composition.fill_the_frame: Subject fills 90%+ of frame, edges cropped. Creates intimacy, intensity, and detail focus. Use for beauty close-ups and product hero shots
composition.diagonal_dynamism: Subjects positioned along diagonal axes (corner to corner). Creates energy, movement, and visual interest. Breaks static feel of horizontal/vertical compositions
composition.frame_within_frame: Architectural or environmental elements create a natural frame around subject (doorway, window, arch). Adds depth, context, and focuses attention

color_theory._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
color_theory.complementary: Opposite colors on wheel — blue/orange, red/green, purple/yellow. Maximum contrast and vibrancy. Use for attention-grabbing ads and energetic designs
color_theory.analogous: Adjacent colors — blue/teal/green or red/orange/yellow. Harmonious, calming, natural. Use for lifestyle, wellness, and organic brands
color_theory.triadic: Evenly spaced colors — red/yellow/blue or orange/green/purple. Vibrant but balanced. Use for playful brands and children's content
color_theory.monochromatic: Single hue in varying lightness/saturation. Sophisticated, minimalist, brand-focused. Use for luxury and premium positioning
color_theory.split_complementary: Base color plus two adjacent to its complement. Less tension than complementary, more nuanced. Use for refined commercial work

contrast._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
contrast.high_key: Bright, airy, predominantly light tones (80%+ highlights). Conveys optimism, purity, cleanliness. Use for beauty, wellness, minimalist product shots
contrast.low_key: Dark, moody, predominantly shadow tones (70%+ darks). Conveys drama, mystery, luxury. Use for automotive, spirits, high-end fashion
contrast.full_range: Full tonal range from deep blacks to bright whites. Maximum impact and realism. Use for editorial, documentary, and commercial photography
contrast.flat_design: Reduced tonal range, minimal shadows, uniform lighting. Conveys modern, clean, digital-native aesthetic. Use for UI/UX and tech brands

style_references._source: original curated layer shipped with the repo corpus build (no external doc)
style_references.minimalist: Negative space, limited palette, single focal point, clean sans-serif type. Apple, Muji, Kinfolk magazine aesthetic
style_references.brutalist: Raw materials, exposed structure, high contrast, oversized type. Balenciaga, Off-White, underground music aesthetic
style_references.art_deco: Geometric patterns, gold accents, symmetrical layout, luxurious materials. Great Gatsby, vintage travel posters
style_references.bauhaus: Form follows function, primary colors, geometric shapes, grid-based. Modernist design school aesthetic
style_references.memphis: Bold patterns, squiggles, bright contrasting colors, playful shapes. 80s postmodern, contemporary fashion campaigns
style_references.y2k: Chrome, metallic, futuristic, cyber elements, iridescent. Late 90s/early 2000s nostalgia, tech branding
style_references.editorial: Magazine-quality, high production value, storytelling composition. Vogue, Monocle, Kinfolk
style_references.cinematic: Film still quality, anamorphic lens flare, teal-orange grade, shallow depth of field. Roger Deakins, Emmanuel Lubezki inspired
